summary: CleanCore Solutions filed an 8-K reporting entry into a joint venture agreement to form a data center project. The company holds 79% of the JV, contributing cash, while PartnerCo contributes assets and services. The JV has a colocation agreement with Cerebras valued at $800M over 10 years. No special-situation category applies as this is a routine operational agreement, not an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing discloses governance and capital structure, with no board recommendation or advisors. Watch for project completion and revenue commencement in Q1 2027.
